title: Next-Level Rights and Amount-in-Dispute Bases: Appeals and Grievances Tier Schedule
content:
Next-level rights after an Appeals and Grievances decision, and the way each tier states its amount in dispute, are fixed in this schedule.

- *Amount in dispute basis*: how the amount in dispute is figured.
- *Next level*: the next appeal level ("none" where the tier is final).
- *Decided by*: who decides the next level.
- *Next-level deadline*: calendar days after this tier's decision date within which the next level must be asked for (0 means no next level).
- *Next-level minimum*: USD, the least amount in dispute that gives a right to the next level (0.00 means no minimum or no next level).
- *Hearing minimum*: USD, the least amount in dispute that gives a right to a hearing after the next level (0.00 means no hearing right).
- *File forwarding*: calendar days after an escalation request within which the case file is forwarded (0 means not applicable).
- *Appellant's request only*: whether only the appellant's own request moves the case up a level.

| Tier | Amount in dispute basis |
|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | the difference between the allowed amount claimed and the allowed amount paid |
| Beneficiary Grievance | not applicable |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | the denied payment plus the beneficiary liability at issue on the lines |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | not applicable |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | the estimated allowed amount of the requested services, or the denied payment plus liability on the line |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | the estimated allowed amount of the requested services |

| Tier | Next level | Decided by | Next-level deadline (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | none | not applicable | 0 |
| Beneficiary Grievance | none | not applicable | 0 |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | formal review | Defense Health Agency appeals division | 60 |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | none | not applicable | 0 |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | second-level reconsideration | national quality monitoring contractor | 90 |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | expedited second-level reconsideration | national quality monitoring contractor | 3 |

| Tier | Next-level minimum (USD) | Hearing minimum (USD) | File forwarding (calendar days) | Appellant's request only |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | yes |
| Beneficiary Grievance | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | yes |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | 50.00 | 300.00 | 10 | yes |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | yes |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 0.00 | 300.00 | 10 | yes |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 0.00 | 300.00 | 1 | yes |

**Illustrations from the schedule (hypothetical amounts)**

- A Claim Factual Reconsideration decided with an amount in dispute of 49.99 USD is below that tier's 50.00 USD next-level minimum; at 50.00 USD it meets it.
- A Medical Necessity Reconsideration has no next-level minimum (0.00), but a hearing after its next level needs at least 300.00 USD in dispute.
- Three tiers have no next level at all: the Allowable Charge Review, the Beneficiary Grievance and the Enrollment Reinstatement Review.
